ValidationRule.description: Approved Balanced Transfer Amount Must be less than or equal to Approved Credit Limit
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $User.LastName <> 'Integration', ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Credit Card Application'), ISPICKVAL(Sub_Type__c, 'New Credit Card'), ISPICKVAL(cc_Approved_Requested_Card_Type__c, 'PLATINUM_BALANCE_TRANSFER_01'), ISPICKVAL(Region_Flag__c, 'Bahrain'), OR( AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Approved_Credit_Limit__c), cc_Approved_Credit_Limit__c < cc_Approved_Balance_Transfer_Amount__c ), AND( ISCHANGED(cc_Approved_Balance_Transfer_Amount__c), NOT(ISBLANK(cc_Approved_Credit_Limit__c)), cc_Approved_Balance_Transfer_Amount__c > cc_Approved_Credit_Limit__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Approved balance transfer amount must be equal to or less than the approved credit limit
